facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts operates brick-and-mortar stores and the DMart Ready e-commerce platform.
facts.quote: Notwithstanding the opportunities that are available in DMart Ready. We do that too. But it is not either / or. I keep saying brick-and-mortar and e-commerce is the way to go.

facts.statement: Apparel and general merchandise represent categories with specific talent-driven management requirements.
facts.quote: Apparel is very, very talent driven and individual driven - the guy or the lady who's running that specific category, how he or she thinks about what should be done.

facts.statement: DMart Ready home deliveries beyond 24 hours occur because customers purposefully choose a later delivery date.
facts.quote: and then balance 14%, why it doesn't happen is because customers plan the date of delivery. It's not that we can't do it, but when we give them visibility on when do they want their slot, they purposefully pick a date, which is later
